ClientResponses.Response:
Your feedback is very important to us. We are very sorry to hear about your experience with the rust on your grill. We are here to help.

If your grill is located in a coastal or humid area, or if chlorine is present in your environment, additional maintenance will be needed to keep up the appearance of the exterior steel parts.

Also, below are a couple helpful tips.

At the first sign of staining/discoloration/surface rust we would recommend cleaning with stainless steel cleaner (ex. Bar Keepers Friend). Once cleaned, we recommend using a stainless steel polish (ex. Weber's brand) to keep it looking its best in-between cleanings.

Once a week we would recommend wiping down the grill with a wet towel or rag and then drying completely.

We would only recommend covering your grill if you know inclement weather is coming.

The quicker you get at a stain the easier it will be to clean off.

Our Care team is reaching out to assist you further. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

ClientResponses.Response:
Your feedback means a lot to us. We are very sorry to hear about your burner tubes and the peeling inside the lid. We are here to help. 

It's very common to see a substance on the inside of your grill lid that looks like peeling or flaking paint, or some sort of finish that is delaminating.

However, we don't apply any paint or finish to the inside of our grill lids that can peel in the manner you described. 

As you use your grill, vapors and grease from the grilling process can build up and create a deposit on the inside of your grill lid.

The high heat of the grill will cause the deposit to harden, and it will begin to flake or peel off.

This peeling or flaking substance will be paper thin, black, and glossy on one side and matte on the other, and is known as carbonized grease.

Our Care team will be reaching out to follow up. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together.
